main_text.l: tat apud me. {b}Qvòd verò is viveret
sex-culo sexto vergente ad septimum, habe-
mus non solùm ex Masoretarum Monu-
mentis, sed etiam ex Jacobitarum, Mel-
litam, ac in sexta Synodo damnatum,
sunt qvi scribunt; sed qvàm oscitanter,
plane constat, {c}cùm hujus rei nec ve-
stigium, nec vola in actis illius Synodi,
qvi Monothelitæ sunt, uti & omnes reli-
{b} Non ita profecto antiqvus est scriptor ille,
vel ejus scripta, qvæ nondum in lucem e-
ut sanctum venerantur, non fuisse hæreti-
cum; de his consulatur ipse Morinus libro

page.notes: The text is set in roman type with italic-free body. Footnote (b) and (c) are split into two paragraphs. Doubtful: "vola" (line "nec vola in actis") is read as printed but may be damaged; "suppositicia" in the first footnote is partly obscured. Show-through and a faint mark near the left margin were left out.
